result.content: # Complete the required API and report.

Stage 1: configuration_changes; work sample 0.
Implement evaluate(request, policy). Start with policy.defaults and apply layers in order. Unknown keys fail with unknown_key. Null resets to defaults only when policy.null_resets is true. Environment overrides require policy.environment and known keys. Parse boolean only from exact true/false strings; parse integers only from signed decimal strings. Invalid environment values fail with environment. Enforce exact policy types; booleans are not integers. Type failures use type. Return {ok, config, error}; failures have empty config, successes have null error. Preserve explicit false, zero, and empty strings.
Write work.py with this API. Also write report.json as a JSON array of evaluate results for requests.json, using current policy.json and evidence.json when present. Keep prior supported behavior. Use actual local checks. Store findings and unresolved limits for the next agent.

command: import json; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); print(json.dumps([evaluate(r,p) for r in rs],sort_keys=True)); cases=[({'layers':[{'x':1}]},p),({'layers':[{'retries':True}]},p),({'layers':[{'label':''}]},p),({'layers':[{'enabled':None}]},p),({'layers':[],'environment':{'retries':'2'}},p)]; print(json.dumps([evaluate(r,q) for r,q in cases],sort_keys=True))
